GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Shortly after straightening struck heels of runner resulting in runner becoming  momentarily unbalanced. Lost momentum and was fully tested following this incident. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
